name: RWP Page Builder
author: React-WP
description: A visual drag-and-drop page builder: sections, columns and widgets, responsive styling, dynamic data tags, posts grids, forms, sliders, global colours and fonts, templates and revisions.

retains: Saved layouts stay in pages.builder_data: those are core columns, and site templates (header, footer, single post) are rendered by core.
A page with a layout falls back to its classic editor content while the builder is uninstalled.
